name_zh: 曾子/战国/孝道本体法与修身体系
description_zh: Zengzi (Ma 505-435 BCE), named Shen, is a disciple of Confucius. Recognized as 'Zong Sheng (Mother Saint)', he is a key figure in the Confucian lineage transmission — Zengzi transmitted to Zisi (Kong You), Zisi to Zhen, forming the 'Confucius-Zengzi-Zisi-Mencius' Confucian lineage.
